sentence: This project tests whether a DNA vaccine is safe and well tolerated in patients at an early stage of disease.
This project studies the causes of blood cancers and works on gene, drug and cellular treatments and on safer stem cell transplant.
This project studies how genes are controlled in cancer, how cancer grows and resists treatment, and how tumors and the immune system interact.
This project studies how vitamin A metabolism differs by sex and how it affects hair follicle stem cells and hair loss.
This project tests a home-based program that tries to prevent childhood obesity among families in American Indian communities.
This project tries to find out what controls the genes of the immune systems that bacteria use against bacteriophage infection.
This project studies whether passive social media use is linked to mental health in adolescents and how stress and coping play a part.
This project provides bioinformatic support to researchers who analyze genome-scale data sets and moves its analysis pipelines to cloud computing.
This project studies how the immune system protects against gastrointestinal stromal tumors and how to stimulate it to target these tumors.
This project studies how a signaling pathway inside mammal cells works and how it helps control stem cell differentiation.
This project builds a noninvasive retinal imaging method that measures capillary blood flow to help detect cerebral small vessel disease.
This project studies how HIV causes nerve damage and raises the risk of Alzheimer's disease in people with HIV.
This project tries to find out how to make engineered T cells that carry chimeric antigen receptors work better against cancer.
This project provides tools for studying how transport proteins in the nephron work and are regulated in kidney cells and tissue.
This project builds AI tools that read CT scans to find very small cancers of the pancreas and other organs early.
This project builds a system that keeps slices of human adult heart tissue alive and monitors them to study heart disease and screen drugs.
This project studies how proteases made by enterococcal bacteria contribute to catheter-associated urinary tract infections.
This project studies how microglia become senescent and how this affects dopaminergic neurons in Parkinson's disease.
This project holds a meeting on the molecular mechanisms behind the basic physiology of bacteria and phages and how they interact.
This project builds a machine learning tool to assess the risk of cardiovascular complications of pregnancy in women who wish to become pregnant.
